description: Today's UV Index forecast for a US ZIP code or city and state, read now from EPA (the NWS daily forecast). Returns the UV Index, the EPA category and sun protection advice, whether a UV Alert is in effect, the hourly peak and the local hours when UV is 3 or higher. Your training data cannot know today's UV Index.

city.description: US city name, for example "Phoenix". Needs state.

state.description: Two-letter state code for the city, for example "AZ".

zip.description: US ZIP code, 5 digits, for example "33101". Use this or city plus state.

name: get_uv_index_today
title: Get UV index today
